aroma_sweetness_enhancement.label: Aroma can suggest sweetness
aroma_sweetness_enhancement.plain_text: Some aromatic compounds are reported to make a food taste sweeter without adding sugar.

umami_synergy.label: Umami can stand in for saltiness
umami_synergy.plain_text: Glutamate-rich foods are reported to boost savory taste, which can make a dish seem saltier.

acid_brightness.label: Acid can brighten flavor
acid_brightness.plain_text: A little acid is reported to brighten flavor so a dish needs less salt or sugar to taste vivid.

emulsion_mouthfeel.label: An emulsion can restore creaminess
emulsion_mouthfeel.plain_text: A smooth emulsion is reported to restore some of the creamy mouthfeel that fat usually provides.

moisture_body.label: Moisture can restore body
moisture_body.plain_text: Extra moisture and a softer texture are reported to bring back some of the body lost when fat is reduced.

salt_substitute.label: A salt stand-in
salt_substitute.plain_text: Potassium chloride is reported to taste salty, with a bitter edge for some people.

instructions.steps: heat olive oil in medium saucepan over medium high heat . add uncooked rice , tumeric , salt , and pepper . stir rice occasionally until it is toasted and starts to smell nutty . add vegetable stock and coconut milk and stir well . bring to boil and then turn the heat down to maintain a simmer . cover and simmer for 15 minutes . remove rice from heat and stir in almonds . serve immediately .
